name: 5-APDB
summary: An entactogenic amphetamine stimulant with similar structure and effects to MDMA. An analogue of MDA, it is a highly selective serotonin releaser but inhibits reuptake of serotonin (weakly), dopamine and norepinephrine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: In animal drug discrimination studies, 5-APDB's effects generalize most closely to non-stimulant MDMA analogues such as MBDB and MMAI, while producing no substitution for LSD or amphetamine. In vitro studies show that 5-APDB acts as a highly selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA), with IC50 values of 130 nM, 7,089 nM, and 3,238 nM for inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, respectively.
pharmacology.kind: Entactogen; Serotonin releasing agent; Serotonin receptor modulator

uses.text: 5-APDB was developed by a team led by David E. Nichols at Purdue University as part of their research into non-neurotoxic analogues of MDMA and first described in 1993.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: David Nichols's team at Purdue developed it in 1993 while searching for MDMA-like drugs that would not damage serotonin nerve endings.
fact.zh: David Nichols在普渡大學的團隊於1993年開發了它，當時他們正在尋找不會損傷血清素神經末梢的類MDMA藥物。
fact.zhHans: David Nichols在普渡大学的团队于1993年开发了它，当时他们正在寻找不会损伤血清素神经末梢的类MDMA药物。
